name: lazyforensic
description: Antigravity + Gemini 3.7 Flash evidence-drafting helper with Korean help prompts for timelines, file metadata, reports, UI, and Kakao text exports. Not a forensic acquisition or court-admissibility suite.

interface.shortDescription: Gemini 3.7 Flash DFIR drafting for Antigravity
interface.longDescription: LazyForensic is tuned for Google Antigravity + Gemini 3.7 Flash. SessionStart injects GEMINI.md. Four lanes (forensic/visual/legal/ui) reach vendor catalogs through INDEX files. The default skill picker stays thin (12 SKILL.md). Skills use invoke_subagent (Model flash/pro/flash_lite) and fail closed when evidence is missing.
